name: ford_voodoo_52
label: Ford 5.2 L "Voodoo" V8 (Shelby GT350, flat-plane crank)

sources.what: Wikipedia, Ford Modular engine, Voodoo section. Bore, stroke, CR, ratings, redline, firing order, crank layout (citing MotorTrend and Car and Driver).
MotorTrend (Frank Markus, 3 June 2015), technical briefing from Ford's engine team. Crank layout, lift, throttle, manifold and exhaust design.
Street Muscle magazine, 'Inside Ford's New 5.2L Shelby GT350 Engine'. Valve diameters, R/L firing pattern and Ford bank numbering.
EngineLabs report of Ford's final spec release. Bore/stroke in inches, .551 in lift, 87 mm throttle.
WardsAuto interview with chief engineer Eric Ladner. Ratings with Nm, development targets.
f150hub spec table. 32 valves, roller finger followers, max engine speed.

notes: Sourced: bore, stroke, compression, firing order 1-5-4-8-3-7-2-6 with Ford numbering (1-4 right bank, 5-8 left), flat-plane crank with throws up-down-up-down, four valves per cylinder and their diameters, 14 mm peak lift on both cams, 87 mm throttle, 8250 rpm redline, X-shaped cross-over. Estimated, not sourced: rod length (150.7 mm is an aftermarket rod's quoted length seen only in a search summary), cam timing and duration (the engine has variable cam timing; one fixed timing is used), intake runner length and diameter, exhaust primary length and diameter, pipe sizes, idle speed. The real headers are 4-into-3-into-1 per bank; the definition format has one collector per group, so they are entered as 4-into-1 per bank. Left to the simulator's defaults: plenum and airbox volumes, collector volume, muffler, flywheel inertia. Also estimates: friction_scale, heat_q, burn_scale (the simulator's friction, heat-release and burn-rate scales), set with the other estimated fields so that simulated torque and power come near the published figures; no sourced number was changed.

vehicle.name: Ford Mustang Shelby GT350 (2016)
vehicle.notes: Tremec TR-3160 six-speed manual, the only gearbox. Gear ratios from Wikipedia's TR-3160 table (citing Tremec); final drive and tyres from an enthusiast reference quoting Ford's launch material; curb weight from a spec database. Ford's own tech-spec sheet refused automated access, so it was not read. wheel_radius_m is my calculation from the rear tyre size (unloaded radius). Top speed omitted (not found).
